title: Flowers for Algernon
author: Daniel Keyes
summary: Charlie Gordon, a kind man with a low IQ, is offered an experimental surgery that may make him intelligent. The novel is told through his own progress reports, and his writing changes as he does.
readIf: you like short, emotional science fiction that cares more about people than gadgets.
skipIf: you want an upbeat story or hard science, since the heart of it is sadness and ethics.

pairings.reason: Another quiet, devastating novel where a science-fiction idea is used to look at what a life is worth.
A short, compassionate story about a gentle man with an intellectual disability and a world that is unkind to him.
A tender, observant narrator slowly reveals how others treat and value them, in a softer near-future setting.
